english.note: Use this when the sense is specifically the central point or focal area of a place or arrangement.
Use this for the literal or organizational centre rather than the essential core of an issue.
Use this for the central point of a circle, place, or other object rather than a section between two ends.
Use 中心 for the physical centre of a space, shape, or area rather than its important idea.
Use this for the literal central part or point of something, rather than its organizing core.

examples.english: A Christmas tree was placed in the midst of the square.
examples.traditional: 廣場中心擺咗棵聖誕樹。
